# unifi_protect_chime (Resource)

A UniFi Protect Chime, identified by MAC. Configures the existing, adopted device over the private Protect API (`/proxy/protect/api/chimes/<id>`): name, speaker volume, ring repeat count, and the doorbell cameras it rings for. `terraform destroy` removes the chime from state and leaves it configured; set `forget_on_destroy = true` to unadopt it. Per-doorbell ringtone overrides (`ringSettings`) are not modeled — they reference uploaded ringtone objects the provider does not model. **Config writes are HIL-unverified — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac` (String) Chime MAC address (the natural key); any separator/case is accepted and normalized. The device must be adopted. Immutable — changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `camera_ids` (Set of String) Object ids of the doorbell cameras this chime rings for.
- `forget_on_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, `terraform destroy` unadopts (forgets) the chime instead of just removing it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `name` (String) Chime display name.
- `repeat_times` (Number) How many times the chime repeats per ring.
- `volume` (Number) Speaker volume (0–100).

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Current management IP/host.
- `id` (String) Protect object id (24-hex). Import key.
- `is_adopted` (Boolean) Whether the chime is adopted by this console.
- `model` (String) Hardware model.
- `state` (String) Connection state.
